name: Coward // Killer
oracle_text:
Target creature can't block this turn and becomes a Coward in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Time travel.
Killer deals 3 damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a creature type with it.

needs.what: an op that, for each suspended card the controller owns (in exile, suspended, with time counters) and each permanent they control with a time counter on it, lets them choose to add one time counter, remove one, or do nothing; removing the last time counter from a suspended card must cast it without paying its mana cost as suspend does (702.62), through the same counter-removed funnel
needs.why_existing_wont_do: for_each + choose_mode over add_counters/remove_counters is the near miss, but no selector key reads 'suspended' (has_counters in exile also matches non-suspended exiled cards with time counters), and the free cast on removing the last counter lives only in suspend's upkeep tick, so an effect removing it would strand the card in exile. The rest of the card is expressible: Coward is cant_block + add_subtype with duration this turn on a target creature, and Killer is a second_face split half whose damage reaches each other creature via shares_a_creature_type_with on the target plus exclude_binding.
